summary: Forum topic 56 post 218: FT-2900 read reaches the 'press SET MHz' step then fails with a header error. Stock ft2900 requires the 10-byte ID to equal one IDBLOCK; FT-2900E (41 02) and TX-modified (C7 01) radios send others, and CHIRP keeps the E class unregistered. Need the received header (in-app report) and the radio's label variant.
title: Read stops after 'press MHz' with a header error
